title: Show HN: Are You in the Weights?
guide_zh: Are You in the Weights? 查询多个模型，看看自己的痕迹是否被语言模型认识。
author: turtlesoup
excerpt: With more traffic moving off-web and into LLMs, I got curious about what traces we leave "in the weights". My design partner and I built a site in the past few weeks that checks recognition across frontier and small models. It queries many of them in parallel, clusters the responses, and tells you how strongly they recognize you. Happy to answer any questions here!

excerpt: Hi all! TikZ is a widely-used LaTeX package for drawing figures in papers. It uses commands like \draw[->] (0,0) -- (1,2); to draw lines, shapes, text, etc. Academics usually code up their figures by hand, so there is lots of twiddling around with the coordinates and recompiling until things look nice. It generates a hands-on, source-backed tutorial for any technical topic you want to learn.
